_doc: EXAMPLE unit FX bindings — the PLAN-fx-offload.md §2 declarative binding
format, shown for a line tank (ms_tanks_s2). Copy per unit to e.g.
client/units/<def>/bindings.json (or export the same table from Lua). The
binding interpreter (fx-offload X4, fx-bindings.ts) evaluates all bindings
for all visible entities each frame in SoA batches — no per-entity script.
`effect` / `sound` values are NAMES resolved through effects/library.json and
gamedata/sounds.lua; unit-slot effects (death / damage / movement) should
prefer `slot:` refs resolved through effects/unit-fx.json so class-wide
retunes stay one edit — literal effect names remain legal for bespoke units.
`when` is the tiny condition vocabulary (anim state, health threshold,
pieceRotating, velocity threshold) — NOT a language. Weapon muzzle/impact/
fire-sound normally come from effects/weapon-fx.json keyed by the firing
weapon; a per-unit `onEvent weapon_fired` binding here only adds
unit-specific choreography (recoil anim, shell-eject) on top.

burning._doc: -> fire_burning; open flames when nearly dead

gunFire._doc: muzzle effect + fire sound come from weapon-fx.json; this binding only adds the recoil clip

onDeath._doc: unit-fx death slot: ms_tanks_s2 -> death_vehicle_s2 (scaleOverrides bump s1/s3/s4)
